SELECT TYPE, VERSION FROM SYSIBM.SYSPACKAGE WHERE COLLID = '{{SCHEMA}}' AND NAME = '{{TRIGGER}}'

preflight: SELECT SCHEMA, NAME FROM SYSIBM.SYSTRIGGERS WHERE SCHEMA = '{{SCHEMA}}' AND NAME = '{{TRIGGER}}'
SELECT COLLID, NAME, VERSION FROM SYSIBM.SYSPACKAGE WHERE COLLID = '{{SCHEMA}}' AND NAME = '{{TRIGGER}}'
prerequisites: Configure the SQL processor outer terminator as @ and preserve lines/comments; SPUFI SQLFORMAT SQLPL is required for the comment fixtures.
The newly created subject table must have no row or column access control and no pending definition changes. Verify CREATEIN, subject-table, and trigger-package authority.
The long-comment body exceeds 6000 characters deliberately. Preserve the complete SYSTRIGGERS.STATEMENT CLOB, not unused SYSTRIGGERS.TEXT.
Behavior probes run only for accepted positive cases, in listed order on the fresh owned table, and require INSERT, UPDATE, SELECT, and DELETE authority.

probes.sql: SELECT STATEMENT FROM SYSIBM.SYSTRIGGERS WHERE SCHEMA = '{{SCHEMA}}' AND NAME = '{{TRIGGER}}'

expected.export: Lossless full CLOB; preserve line breaks, comments, case, literal whitespace, and doubled quotes.
expected.comparison: Capture only. Full CREATE text contains relocated schema names. Compare the body using a statement-aware extraction or direct review; never blanket-replace names.

probes.notes: Run once on the empty case table.

probes.sql: UPDATE {{SCHEMA}}.{{TABLE}} SET QA_VALUE = QA_VALUE WHERE ID = 1
probes.notes: Preserves the INSERT-trigger result or invokes the UPDATE-trigger result.

probes.sql: SELECT ID, QA_VALUE, LENGTH(QA_VALUE) AS VALUE_LENGTH FROM {{SCHEMA}}.{{TABLE}} WHERE ID = 1
probes.notes: Export QA_VALUE losslessly. Do not trim or fold case.
